description.fun: Ditto can turn itself into an exact copy of anything it sees, though it gets the details wrong when it works from memory, and it can't hold a shape while it's laughing. It sleeps disguised as a rock to avoid being attacked. Look closely at its face: Game Freak's designers said Ditto was originally based on the smiley face, and its eyes and mouth are exactly like ':)'.
description.guide: A pink-purple, blob-like Normal Pokémon that can transform into an exact copy of any creature or object. It does not evolve and has no other forms. In the games, it can breed with almost any Pokémon to produce Eggs.
description.tagline: A smiley blob that can become anything
